title: Business insights
seo_description: Lab business insights: billing, collections, and dues across centers, revenue by day and center, top referring doctors, and week-over-week comparison.

fields.hero_title: See what every center, day, and doctor brings in
fields.hero_lead: Track billing, collections, and outstanding dues across all your centers, compare this week with last, and see which referring doctors and partner labs drive your business.
fields.features:
Billed, collected, and outstanding
Revenue by day and by center
Home collection and B2B revenue
Dues by patient and partner lab
Top referring doctors with trends
Week-over-week comparison

steps.title: Bill as you work
steps.text: Every case is billed at registration, so numbers update as the day goes on.

steps.title: Compare
steps.text: See this week against last, center against center, and doctor against doctor.

steps.title: Act
steps.text: Follow up on dues and invest in the referral relationships that grow your lab.

fields.cta_title: See business insights with your own setup
fields.cta_text: Bring your test menu and price list. We will show you a patient case from registration to signed report, configured the way your team works.
